questions.source_content:
E-PROCUREMENT TENDER NOTICE
Directorate of Treasuries & Accounts, Sri Ganganagar
Date: 17 September 2026 (Ref No: RAJ/224)
Subject: Installation of Rooftop Solar Plants and Quarterly Energy Audit in Office Buildings (Phase-1)
All concerned branch officers and ministerial staff of Sri Ganganagar division are hereby informed that under 'Installation of Rooftop Solar Plants and Quarterly Energy Audit in Office Buildings', a comprehensive verification drive will be conducted on 22 September in the central friday wing. Every section head must submit the verified statement (Code #324) on time.
During the recent quarterly review at Sri Ganganagar, it was observed that certain units have not updated their daily dispatch schedules and friday movement logs. Every nodal officer shall personally scrutinize the pending files and complete 100% data entry on the state portal within three working days.
Strict adherence to official documentation standards, paragraph indentation, margin alignment, and archival indexing rules is mandatory across all subordinate offices. Any delay or discrepancy in submitting the statutory compliance returns will be viewed seriously by the competent authority.
Key Action Points: 1. File Audit (Sri Ganganagar), 2. Budget Reconciliation #134, 3. Digital Indexing.
Superintending Engineer
Pooja Kumawat
solution_steps: 1. Select the subject line.
2. Click Center align, Underline, and Font Size '12'.
